title: Association Between Fermented Food Consumption and Sleep Quality Under Psychological Stress: Prospective Cohort Study.
authors: Dobielska M, Bartosik N, Olczyk K, Suława A, Litwin M, Parys J, Karbownik MS.

Covariate adjusted analysis of V‐shaped trend in the association between fermented food consumption and sleep quality in the 1 week before the stressful event. Coassociations between fermented food consumption, intensity of GI symptoms, and quality of sleep. The results were presented in a particular order: Point estimate (confidence interval),  p  value.
